facts.text: Clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society.
facts.ended_how: replaced: the deal was renegotiated so the goblins wall off the stairs and keep the upper rooms instead of a cleared mound

facts.text: A huge undead with a greatsword in the Barrow Mound stands in the way (see thread_4).
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: the party left Sir Alfred incapacitated and the goblins agreed to wall him off rather than have the mound cleared

facts.text: Wayman promised Snurk and the Free Goblin Society that he will never tell King Hogboon where the goblins are.

The Free Goblin Society (Watak the Scribbler, Grimble Who Holds the Stick, Snurk the Walkout, Peg Who Had the Torch), friendly to the party, now hold the Barrow Mound's church, antechamber and statue room, walling off the stairs down, and plan to destroy the church.
